nodes.name: Core Manipulation & Resource Transfer
nodes.description: Core flow, reserve transfers, Void charging, soul core routing, payment and cost reduction.

nodes.name: Continuous Effects & Static Modifiers
nodes.description: BP modifications, symbol modification, color treating, passive protections (Armor, Heavy Armor, Immunity).

nodes.name: Replacement Effects & Destruction Prevention
nodes.description: Prevention of destruction, depletion or bounce, redirecting zones, remain on field mechanics.

nodes.name: Timing Windows & Activation Conditions
nodes.description: Step/phase triggers, When Destroyed, Flash timing, combat trigger evaluation, structured conditions.

nodes.name: Target Resolution & Candidate Filtering
nodes.description: Multi-criteria target querying, candidate validation, prompt decision resolution, redirection.

nodes.name: Special Card Type Mechanics
nodes.description: Subsystems for Brave (fusion/separation), Mirage (set/trigger), Grandwalker Nexuses (divine skills), Contract cards (soul state), Ultimates (U-trigger), and Advent.

nodes.name: Keyword Ability Delegation
nodes.description: Delegation to specialized keyword handlers (Curse, Confront, Tribute, Immortal, Awakening, Bound, etc.).

nodes.name: Deck & Hand Manipulation
nodes.description: Drawing, discarding, deck search, milling, revealing, and bottom-deck bounce.

dependencies.reason: Continuous BP/level computation requires active cores on stacks
Candidate filtering often evaluates core counts in reserve/trash
Replacement effects evaluate protection modifiers and effective BP
Timing triggers depend on active abilities enabled at specific levels
Triggered effects resolve target selections through interaction prompt
Target selection drives card movement, bounce destinations, and hand swaps
Special card types (Brave, Mirage, Grandwalker, Contract) require specialized core and soul core routing
Keyword abilities resolve continuous rules and combat modifications
